terms.en: PDB ID for the experimentally determined odorant-free OR10–Orco complex

terms.en: PDB ID for the experimentally determined o-cresol-bound OR10–Orco complex
terms.zh: PDB 結構編號：實驗解析、已結合鄰甲酚的 OR10–Orco 複合體

terms.en: Protein Data Bank, the archive of molecular 3D structures
terms.zh: Protein Data Bank，保存分子三維結構的資料庫

terms.en: Database of Odorant Responses; integrates published fly odor-response profiles
terms.zh: Database of Odorant Responses，整合果蠅氣味反應資料的資料庫

terms.en: public chemical database used here to identify odorant structures
terms.zh: 公開化學資料庫；本研究用來核對氣味分子的化學結構

terms.en: public database of precomputed AlphaFold structure predictions
terms.zh: 公開保存預先計算之 AlphaFold 結構預測的資料庫

terms.en: AI system that predicts protein 3D structures from sequence
terms.zh: 從蛋白序列預測三維結構的 AI 系統

terms.en: protein-structure prediction workflow built around AlphaFold and fast sequence searches
terms.zh: 結合 AlphaFold 與快速序列搜尋的蛋白結構預測流程

terms.en: protein language model used here to turn sequences into numerical features
terms.zh: 蛋白語言模型；此處將胺基酸序列轉為數值特徵

terms.en: a numerical vector representing a sequence or molecule
terms.zh: 代表序列或分子資訊的數值向量

terms.en: infrared absorption: how a molecule absorbs light at different vibrational frequencies
terms.zh: 紅外線吸收：分子對不同振動頻率光線的吸收

terms.en: a fixed-length descriptor formed by smoothing equally weighted normal-mode frequencies
terms.zh: 將等權重正常振動頻率平滑後，形成固定長度的描述子

terms.en: Principal Odor Map; OpenPOM is its open-source reproduction for learned molecular odor features
terms.zh: Principal Odor Map；OpenPOM 為其開源重現版，用來學習分子氣味特徵

terms.en: principal component analysis, which compresses features along directions of greatest variation
terms.zh: 主成分分析，依特徵變異方向壓縮維度

terms.en: US National Institute of Standards and Technology; its Chemistry WebBook supplies spectral records
terms.zh: 美國國家標準暨技術研究院；Chemistry WebBook 提供分子頻譜資料

terms.en: fraction of aligned amino-acid positions that are identical
terms.zh: 對齊後胺基酸位置相同的比例

terms.en: odorant receptor 10 from Aedes aegypti, the yellow-fever mosquito
terms.zh: 埃及斑蚊 Aedes aegypti 的第 10 號氣味受體

terms.en: the odorant-receptor co-receptor from Aedes aegypti
terms.zh: 埃及斑蚊的氣味受體共同受體

terms.en: the odorant-receptor co-receptor from the fig wasp Apocrypta bakeri
terms.zh: 榕小蜂 Apocrypta bakeri 的氣味受體共同受體

terms.en: odorant-receptor co-receptor, a shared partner that forms the channel with the odor-selective OR
terms.zh: 氣味受體共同受體，與辨識氣味的 OR 一起組成離子通道

terms.en: odorant receptor, the odor-selective subunit
terms.zh: odorant receptor，負責辨識氣味的受體次單元

terms.en: one of the named Drosophila melanogaster odorant receptors in our design panel
terms.zh: 本研究設計組合中的黑腹果蠅 Drosophila melanogaster 氣味受體名稱

terms.en: an Anopheles gambiae odorant receptor; Ag identifies the mosquito species
terms.zh: Anopheles gambiae 蚊子的氣味受體名稱；Ag 表示物種

terms.en: wild type: the unmutated reference sequence
terms.zh: wild type，未加入設計突變的野生型序列

terms.en: the odorant-free state
terms.zh: 未結合氣味分子的狀態

terms.en: the odorant-bound state
terms.zh: 已結合氣味分子的狀態

terms.en: 2-methylphenol, the odorant resolved in 8V02
terms.zh: 鄰甲酚，又稱 2-methylphenol；8V02 中觀察到的氣味分子

terms.en: cryo-electron microscopy: reconstructing molecular structures from electron images of frozen samples
terms.zh: 冷凍電子顯微鏡：由冷凍樣本的電子影像重建分子結構

terms.en: computationally placing and scoring ligand poses in a receptor
terms.zh: 分子對接：搜尋分子在受體中的位置與朝向，並計算分數

terms.en: mutant docking score minus the corresponding wild-type score
terms.zh: 突變體 docking 分數減去相應野生型分數

terms.en: AutoDock Vina docking score; lower scores are more favorable in this model, not a measured response
terms.zh: AutoDock Vina 對接分數；在此模型中越低越有利，並非實測反應大小

terms.en: software that aligns 3D molecular structures
terms.zh: 比較並對齊分子三維結構的軟體

terms.en: molecular dynamics: computing atomic motion step by step from a force field
terms.zh: 分子動力學：依力場逐步計算原子如何運動

terms.en: steered molecular dynamics: MD with an applied guiding force
terms.zh: 牽引式分子動力學：在 MD 中加入外力引導運動

terms.en: the software engine that integrates the atomic equations of motion
terms.zh: 逐步計算原子運動方程式的模擬引擎

terms.en: predicted local structure confidence on a 0–100 scale; higher is more confident
terms.zh: 局部結構預測信心分數，範圍 0–100；越高表示模型越有信心

terms.en: predicted aligned error, an estimate of uncertainty in relative residue placement; lower is more confident
terms.zh: 預測對齊誤差，估計殘基彼此相對位置的不確定度；越低越有信心

terms.en: root-mean-square deviation: positional difference after the stated structural alignment
terms.zh: 均方根偏差：依指定方式對齊後，原子位置的整體差異

terms.en: root-mean-square error relative to the selected reference values
terms.zh: 均方根誤差：相對指定參考值的整體誤差

terms.en: alpha-carbon atoms, used to trace the protein backbone
terms.zh: α 碳原子，用來描述蛋白質主鏈骨架

terms.en: labels for the third and sixth membrane-spanning helices of OR10
terms.zh: OR10 第三與第六段跨膜螺旋的結構編號

terms.en: an atomic interaction potential; only its positive repulsive part is summed in our clash scans
terms.zh: 描述原子交互作用的位能；此處碰撞掃描只加總其中的正值排斥部分

terms.en: potential of mean force: a free-energy profile along a chosen coordinate
terms.zh: 平均力位能：沿指定反應座標的自由能曲線

terms.en: equations and parameters used to approximate forces between atoms
terms.zh: 用來近似原子間作用力的方程式與參數組

terms.en: a molecule that can bind to a receptor; here, the tested odorant
terms.zh: 能與受體結合的分子，此處指受測氣味分子

terms.en: a local cavity in the receptor that can accommodate the ligand
terms.zh: 受體內可容納配體的局部凹穴

terms.en: a phosphatidylcholine lipid used to build the model membrane
terms.zh: 一種磷脂醯膽鹼脂質，此處用來建立模擬脂膜

terms.en: a three-site water model used in molecular simulations
terms.zh: 以三個作用點描述水分子的模擬模型

terms.en: the Amber parameter set for protein atomic interactions
terms.zh: Amber 系列的蛋白質原子交互作用參數組

terms.en: the Amber parameter set for lipid atomic interactions
terms.zh: Amber 系列的脂質原子交互作用參數組

terms.en: General Amber Force Field; here version 2.2.20 supplies small-molecule parameters
terms.zh: General Amber Force Field；本研究以 2.2.20 版提供小分子力場參數

terms.en: a method for assigning approximate partial charges to ligand atoms
terms.zh: 為配體原子估算部分電荷的方法

terms.en: particle-mesh Ewald, a method for long-range electrostatics in periodic boxes
terms.zh: 粒子網格 Ewald 法，用來計算週期模擬盒中的長程靜電作用

terms.en: constant particle number, volume and temperature
terms.zh: 固定粒子數、體積與溫度的模擬條件

terms.en: standard error of the mean, describing uncertainty in an estimated mean
terms.zh: 平均值標準誤，描述估計平均值的不確定度

terms.en: standard deviation, describing spread among observations
terms.zh: 標準差，描述觀測值的分散程度

terms.en: concentration producing half the maximal response in a specified functional assay
terms.zh: 在指定功能測試中，產生一半最大反應所需的濃度

terms.en: rank correlation, from −1 to +1; it measures ordering, not prediction accuracy as a percentage
terms.zh: 排序相關係數，範圍 −1 至 +1；比較排序是否一致，不是百分比準確率

terms.en: correlation measuring linear similarity between numerical profiles
terms.zh: 衡量數值輪廓線性相似程度的相關係數

terms.en: difference in R² between the compared models
terms.zh: 兩個比較模型之間的 R² 差值

terms.en: coefficient of determination; 1 is perfect, 0 matches the mean baseline, and negative values are worse
terms.zh: 決定係數；1 為完全吻合，0 與平均值基準相當，負值表示比此基準差

terms.en: Benjamini–Hochberg multiple-testing correction; q is the adjusted p-value reported here
terms.zh: Benjamini–Hochberg 多重檢定校正；此處 q 為校正後的 p 值

terms.en: resampling observations or groups to assess statistical uncertainty
terms.zh: 對資料或群組重抽樣，以評估統計不確定度

terms.en: a tree-ensemble prediction model that successively corrects errors using binned features
terms.zh: 以分箱特徵建立決策樹，逐步修正誤差的集成預測模型

terms.en: an ensemble of decision trees with randomized splitting rules
terms.zh: 以隨機切分規則建立多棵決策樹的集成模型

terms.en: an actual sampled conformation selected to represent a cluster
terms.zh: 從已取樣構型中選出的群集代表構型

terms.en: calculated octanol–water partition coefficient on a logarithmic scale, a lipophilicity descriptor
terms.zh: 計算的辛醇／水分配係數對數，用來描述親脂性

terms.en: a defined experimental test of biological activity
terms.zh: 依特定條件進行的生物活性測試

terms.en: amino-acid residues
terms.zh: 胺基酸殘基數

terms.en: neuronal action potentials recorded per second
terms.zh: 每秒記錄到的神經動作電位次數

terms.en: nanometers; 1 nm = 10⁻⁹ meters
terms.zh: 奈米；1 nm＝10⁻⁹ 公尺

terms.en: ångström; 1 Å = 0.1 nm
terms.zh: 埃；1 Å＝0.1 奈米

terms.en: nanoseconds, 10⁻⁹ seconds
terms.zh: 奈秒，10⁻⁹ 秒

terms.en: picoseconds, 10⁻¹² seconds
terms.zh: 皮秒，10⁻¹² 秒

terms.en: femtoseconds, 10⁻¹⁵ seconds
terms.zh: 飛秒，10⁻¹⁵ 秒
